function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

**Pet‑friendly train stations in Miami** | Station | Operator | Address | Pet policy notes | |---------|----------|---------|------------------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (Amtrak & Tri‑Rail)** | Amtrak / Tri‑Rail | 1 SE 1st St, Miami, FL 33131 | • Amtrak allows small pets (≤ 20 lb) in carriers on most trains; larger pets require a “pet ticket” and a carrier.
• Tri‑Rail permits pets in carriers on all local trains.
• The station itself has a dedicated pet‑friendly waiting area and a small pet relief zone. | | **Miami Central Station (Tri‑Rail)** | Tri‑Rail | 1 SE 1st St (same as Intermodal Center) | Same pet‑friendly rules as above. | | **Miami Airport (Tri‑Rail)** | Tri‑Rail | 1 SE 1st St (connected to the airport) | Pets in carriers are allowed on Tri‑Rail; Amtrak does not serve this location. | ### How to travel with a pet from Miami 1. **Amtrak** * Check the Amtrak “Pets” page for the latest rules: https://www.amtrak.com/pets. * Small pets (≤ 20 lb) in carriers can ride for free; larger pets require a pet ticket ($25) and a carrier. * Bring a leash, water bowl, and a small bag of food. * Reserve your pet ticket in advance (online or by calling 1‑800‑AMP‑TRIP). 2. **Tri‑Rail** * Pets in carriers are allowed on all local trains. * No extra fee, but carriers must fit under the seat or in the luggage area. * For longer trips, check the Tri‑Rail pet policy: https://www.tri-rail.com/plan-your-trip/pets. 3. **Station amenities** * The Miami Intermodal Center has a small pet relief area near the entrance. * There are restrooms with pet‑friendly access and a small kiosk selling pet supplies. ### Quick contact info | Service | Phone | Website | |---------|-------|---------| | Amtrak | 1‑800‑AMP‑TRIP (1‑800‑226‑4727) | https://www.amtrak.com | | Tri‑Rail | 1‑305‑226‑4000 | https://www.tri-rail.com | | Miami Intermodal Center | 1‑305‑226‑4000 | https://www.miamitransit.com | **Tip:** Always call ahead or check the online policy before traveling, especially if you have a larger dog or special needs. Happy travels with your furry friend!
